devices_remove_message: {name} loses its access to Comma. Then reset it: hold its button for 10 seconds until it restarts.
devices_remove_elsewhere: It was set up from another phone, so it can still reconnect until you reset it.

devices_removed: Device removed. Hold its button for 10 seconds to reset it.

coding_hint_failed_unknown: The session could not run. Reply to try again.
coding_hint_ended: The session has ended. Its branch stays on GitHub.

coding_changes_truncated: Some changes are too large to show here.
